Simulate Points on the Two-Dimensional Hyperboloid

Source: R/hyperboloid.R
simulate_H2.Rd

Simulate Points on the Two-Dimensional Hyperboloid

Usage

simulate_H2(n, r_max = 8, uniform_area = TRUE)

Arguments

n

Number of points.

r_max

Maximum hyperbolic radius.

uniform_area

If TRUE, sample uniformly with respect to hyperbolic area inside the radius r_max; otherwise sample radius uniformly.

Value

A list with Lorentz coordinates Z, spatial projection S, radius r, and angle theta.

Examples

set.seed(1)
H <- simulate_H2(10, r_max = 2)
head(H$Z)
check_hyperboloid(H$Z)
